title: Warning on escrow agreements used for investment scams and money laundering
summary: The VLSB+C warns that scammers posing as clients and investors are using law practices' trust accounts and escrow services to make investment scams and money laundering look legitimate.
what_changes: Warns against relying on introductions from third parties or existing clients to verify new clients and investors.
Expects thorough identity checks on the client and, where possible, the investor, and an assessment of their ML/TF risk.
Recommends executing escrow agreements directly with the investor and checking investor details with any broker.
Recommends reporting suspected scams to the bank, AUSTRAC, Victoria Police, Scamwatch and the VLSB+C.
who_it_applies_to: Victorian law practices that hold trust money, in particular those preparing escrow agreements or holding and paying out funds as agents.

history.event: VLSB+C issued a warning on escrow agreements being used for investment scams and money laundering.
